xyy.skill.jn50402.name: 剑匣
xyy.skill.jn50402.rule: when the native skill is loaded, the owner's hand limit is five instead of three; discard is required only above five
xyy.skill.jn50402.verifiedBoundary: native ownership graph, setup application, authoritative discard decisions at five and six cards, JSON replay, SQLite restart and six-socket public projection

xyy.skill.jn50501.name: 凝冰焚炎
xyy.skill.jn50501.rule: when a batch contains at least one positive water or fire item targeting the owner, remove every water or fire owner item without IMMUNE_INVAO from that batch, including zero-value siblings
xyy.skill.jn50501.verifiedBoundary: per-item water/fire immunity, thunder non-match, IMMUNE_INVAO bypass, mixed targets, JSON replay, SQLite restart, six-socket response isolation and resumed damage

xyy.skill.jn20202.name: 拒绝
xyy.skill.jn20202.rule: while a normal TP01 is legal, the owner may pay any own TP-category hand card as TP01 and enter the same nested cancellation chain
xyy.skill.jn20202.verifiedBoundary: TP-category filtering, ordinary-card rejection, physical payment, canonical cancel-effect child, nested counter, timeout pass, JSON replay, SQLite restart and six-socket privacy

xyy.skill.jn40301.name: 烹饪
xyy.skill.jn40301.rule: the owner may pay exactly two distinct own hand cards as TP02, using its normal cancellable self-heal mode during action or its direct current-target rescue mode during dying
xyy.skill.jn40301.verifiedBoundary: native ownership, exact two-card payment, action TP02 response chain, rescue priority, cure modifiers, timeout pass, JSON replay, SQLite restart and six-socket privacy

xyy.skill.jn20302.name: 元灵归心术
xyy.skill.jn20302.rule: during her own action phase, the owner may repeatedly discard exactly one own JP-category hand card to directly cure any living player by two
xyy.skill.jn20302.verifiedBoundary: native ownership, JP filtering, any living target including self/full HP, repeat use, direct non-cancellable cure, equipment modifier, timeout no-payment, JSON replay, SQLite restart and six-socket privacy

decisions.ownershipRepresentation: complete static hero-to-skill graph checked byte-for-byte against generated catalog dependencies
decisions.activeSkillRepresentation: native passive lookup is derived from authoritative heroId; dynamic gain/loss state is introduced only when a migrated rule requires it
decisions.jn50402Timing: apply hand limit five atomically when setup finalizes XJ404, matching native G0IS skill loading
decisions.jn50402Visibility: hand limit is public match state; hand identities remain owner-only
decisions.futureHeroChanges: any later hero transformation or dynamic skill ownership node must call the same skill-derived stat recomputation before it can be verified
decisions.jn20202ConversionRepresentation: the paid physical TP-category card and JN20202 source are recorded while the child uses the canonical cancel-effect node shared by normal TP01
decisions.jn20202Timeout: conversion is optional and the existing 15-second reaction timeout is a pass without payment
decisions.jn40301ConversionRepresentation: one command carries the exact two physical payment cards and skill source; action mode creates the canonical TP02 effect while rescue mode enters the existing dying cure path
decisions.jn40301ChoiceProjection: the owner sees one authoritative action with all own eligible hand cards and requiredCardCount two, avoiding quadratic pair enumeration
decisions.jn40301Timeout: both uses are optional; action timeout ends action and rescue timeout passes without paying cards
decisions.activeSkillCommand: active hero skills use a narrow command carrying selected physical cards, target players and a server-validated skill id; each migrated skill owns its exact validation and event semantics
decisions.jn20302Resolution: discard and cure are one authoritative turn event; it does not create a card effect or reaction window because legacy calls Cure directly rather than G0CC
decisions.jn20302RepeatAndTimeout: there is no per-turn marker; the action remains available while another JP hand card exists, and generic optional action timeout ends the phase without payment
